candidates.description: This feature vector represents visual media and photographic equipment, encompassing both still images and moving pictures.
This feature vector represents the spectrum of human emotional states, encompassing both negative feelings of distress and positive feelings of fulfillment.
This vector represents nominal and abstract nouns denoting qualities, capabilities, or states of utility and adoption.
This feature vector represents concepts related to human sexuality, reproduction, and associated anatomical or behavioral terms.
This vector represents verbs and adjectives expressing variability, difference, or fluctuation.
This feature vector represents concepts related to gender studies, social justice, and identity politics.
This feature vector represents the concepts of magnitude, scale, and directional change.
This vector represents verbs expressing internal cognitive states, desires, or necessities.
This feature vector activates on concepts related to the human mind, psychology, and psychoanalysis.
This vector represents the cognitive process of making a choice, reaching a conclusion, or evaluating a situation.
